Hi everybody. Coming back from vacation I wanted a report on current
status, so copied some of the data about the accepted projects from
the google melange site to the wiki. So now it is clear which projects
were accepted and which were not.

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2012

It looks like there are 4 projects that previously were not on the
wiki. Could the students and mentors for these projects please put
project descriptions on the wiki? Also some of the student and mentor
names were unclear from the google site, so could you also please
clarify those when you get some time? The 4 projects in question are

Doug Martin R code for Portfolio Performance Measurement and Benchmarking accepted Andrii Babii

Rafa ? BigMatrix: Super Scalable Predictive Analytics for Big Matrices accepted Fang ?

Roeder ? SAM: A General-purpose classifier for modern predictive data analysis accepted Tour ?

Han Liu Biganalysis: a robust, general-purpose R package for large-scale classification accepted Xiaolin Yang
